description: This file defines a utility class 'AuthenticationConstants' that provides constants, methods for creating authentication-related JSON messages, parsing SASL responses, and extracting common names from distinguished names. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.hono.util' package and appears to be used for handling authentication procedures in a message-oriented middleware framework.

classes.name: AuthenticationConstants
classes.description: Final utility class containing constants and static methods related to authentication processes, including message creation, parsing SASL responses, and extracting information from distinguished names.

methods.name: getAuthenticationRequest
methods.description: Creates a JSON message with mechanism and SASL response for authentication.

methods.name: getAuthenticationReply
methods.description: Creates a JSON message containing the token representing authenticated client.

methods.name: getCommonName
methods.description: Extracts the Common Name (CN) from a subject distinguished name string.

methods.name: parseSaslResponse
methods.description: Parses a SASL PLAIN mechanism response byte array, extracting authorization ID, authentication ID, and password.
